title: Falsification of a differentiation positioning
prompt: A new brand wants to position itself as 'more professional, higher quality'. Please judge whether that is sufficient and propose a way to validate it.
hidden_evaluation: It should point out that generic adjectives struggle to create a perceptible difference, and propose a segment, alternative options, a purchase situation, evidence support and a positioning test that can be falsified.
critical_failures: No competitor alternatives and no customer evidence
